visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with short hair and a brown headband, wearing a striped brown shirt and a black jacket, stands in front of a white and purple partition wall in a mall. She points at the wall and addresses the camera with an inquisitive expression. The lighting is bright and typical of a commercial interior. (2) The woman approaches a vertical slit in the partition wall. She places her hand on the panel and slides it to the left, revealing a bright store interior. As she looks inside, she expresses wide-eyed surprise and excitement. (3) A series of quick cuts showcases the store's interior, featuring wooden display counters with glass tops and a large counter constructed from stacked red bricks. The woman appears briefly in a mirror reflection, filming with her smartphone. (4) Close-up shots highlight design details: a hand touches a rounded metallic clothing rack and then feels the texture of the red brick counter. Blue 'FITTING ROOM' signs are visible on a dark tiled wall. A large wooden sliding door is pushed back to reveal a spacious fitting room with a mirror and warm lighting. (5) The woman stands in the center of the completed store, smiling broadly and gesturing to the clothes on racks and the overall interior design. Graphic text overlays and the brand logo appear as she concludes her introduction.

It uses a curiosity-driven hook—showing what's behind the construction walls—to engage the audience before showcasing the store's unique interior design and aesthetic appeal.
